title: Persons with Disabilities who Applied for Jobs through Employment and Employability Institute
what_it_is: Persons with Disabilities who Applied for Jobs through Employment and Employability Institute

sections.label: Jobseeker disability tracking gap
sections.summary: Workforce Singapore and NTUC's e2i do not track whether jobseekers they assisted have disabilities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Workforce Singapore and NTUC's e2i do not track whether jobseekers assisted have disabilities.

sections.label: Jobseekers with disabilities outcomes
sections.summary: About 900 jobseekers with disabilities were assisted yearly from 2018 to 2022, about 500 placed, and the Enabling Masterplan 2030 targets 40% employment by 2030.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: On average, about 900 jobseekers with disabilities were assisted each year by SG Enable's job placement and job support partners between 2018 and 2022.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Each year, about 500 were successfully placed into jobs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: More than 80% of them remained in employment for at least six months.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The Enabling Masterplan 2030, which was co-developed by the Government, businesses and the community, sets out Singapore's aspirational goal of 40% employment rate for PwDs by 2030.

sections.label: SkillsFuture and inclusive employer support
sections.summary: SkillsFuture Singapore gives PwDs extra course fee subsidies and works with SG Enable on inclusive pedagogies, while inclusive employers get grants and support services.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: For example, SkillsFuture Singapore provides additional course fee subsidies for PwDs and is working with SG Enable to develop curricula in inclusive pedagogies.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: We also provide support to inclusive employers through grants and support services, such as the Enabling Employment Credit.

sections.label: Enabling Business Hub launch
sections.summary: The Enabling Business Hub has been launched to support PwDs in sustaining employment through customised job support and inclusive employer practices.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Members might be interested to know that the Enabling Business Hub has been launched.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: It aims to better support PwDs to sustain employment by providing customised job support and equipping employers with inclusive practices to hire and integrate PwDs.
